people.name: Herod
people.line: Tetrarch of Galilee during Jesus' ministry.

people.name: Herodias
people.line: Wife of Herod Antipas who had John beheaded.

people.name: John
people.line: The Baptist, a prophet who prepared the way for Jesus

people.name: Philip
people.line: Herod Antipas' brother, first husband of Herodias

translations.web: For Herod himself had sent out and arrested John, and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife, for he had married her.
translations.bsb: For Herod himself had ordered that John be arrested and bound and imprisoned, on account of his brother Philip’s wife Herodias, whom Herod had married.
translations.kjv: For Herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon John, and bound him in prison for Herodias' sake, his brother Philip's wife: for he had married her.
translations.asv: For Herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon John, and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip's wife; for he had married her.
